tools.name: list_departments
tools.title: List OPD departments
tools.description: List the outpatient departments of the demo hospital, with the doctor on duty, room number, average minutes per patient, and OPD hours.

tools.name: list_places
tools.title: List hospital places
tools.description: List the demo hospital's places — entrances, counters, services, rooms, waiting halls and facilities — with floor and a plain-language landmark. Optionally filter by floor (0, 1 or 2).

floor.description: Floor to filter by: 0 (ground), 1 (first) or 2 (second). Omit for all floors.

tools.name: find_route
tools.title: Find a route inside the hospital
tools.description: Find the shortest walking route between two places in the demo hospital. Use list_places to get place IDs. Set avoidStairs for a step-free route using the lift and ramp.

avoidStairs.description: When true, the route uses the lift and ramp instead of stairs.
